svg.title: The states of a node in the driver framework
svg.desc: New goes to Connecting on start, Connecting to Connected when the ping is good. A timeout or an error leads to Failed, and a retry after a backoff leads back to Connecting. Stop leads to Stopped; the children of a stopped or failed parent are StoppedByParent.
